title: Practice 1: Prepositional endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Tom grew up in a communist country.
exercises.why: Forming the prepositional case is arguably easier than any other case. In general, add or replace with **е**, but always have **ии** instead of **ие**. The two plural endings, **ах** and **ях**, follow the same rules as the instrumental and dative plurals: after consonants, **o**, or **а**, use the ending **ах**. If such a noun has an irregular nominative plural ending in **я** (e.g., **друг** --> **друзья**), or if the noun ends in **ь**, **й**, **е**, or **я**, the ending is **ях** (e.g., **друг** --> **друзья** --> **друзьях**). — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.
exercises.context: Forming the prepositional case is arguably easier than any other case. (From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0))
